text: Compare what's installed against what's actually available: `apt-cache policy widget-cli`. Look at the Installed line vs. the versions listed in the table below it.

Try the upgrade directly: `sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade widget-cli` (or `sudo apt-get upgrade`). If it reports the package is being 'kept back' or does nothing at all, something is actively preventing the upgrade -- it isn't a missing package or a network problem.
Check for a hold: `apt-mark showhold`. A held package is skipped by `apt-get upgrade`/`install --only-upgrade` entirely, no matter what version is sitting in the mirror.
Lift the hold and retry: `sudo apt-mark unhold widget-cli && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade -y widget-cli`. Confirm with `widget-cli --health`.
